message:
fix(standby): every way to a new capability unties the socket; the old session's tail is observed (keepalive-r2 2 e r2, N2 D1)

Codex codex_ka_e_src_r1.md.

N2 (its probe: first observe 1, after a session 0): the reopen of a socket a session tied to its peer was only in
ObserveFrom (the APK's async owner); a synchronous CapabilityFn (a PC's directory calls) was called with the tied socket
and its observe never came back. Now one UntieForNewCapability for every way to a new capability -- ObserveFrom and
NeedCapability. A reopen never closes a descriptor under a read: a NeedCapability from the owner's thread while the
pump reads is deferred to the pump's next turn, before it starts another read. Steady reuse keeps its endpoint.

D1: what the host still sends after SessionOver -- the old session's video / control from the target -- is counted
(strays) and reported (tailActive: within 1.5 s). An observation of the tail, not a proof that the host's grant ended.
Status carries both (StandbyLease::Snapshot, StandbyRunner::Status). A NeedCapability from the entry's back-off is
noted with its reason.

standby_lease_test 66/66 (x6): a synchronous capability after a session observes from a fresh socket (and again while
the pump reads); the tail active while the old datagrams arrive, then quiet with its count kept. Mutants (the sync path
keeps the tied socket; the tail uncounted) FAIL, earlier ones still FAIL.
